---
title: Data retention
department: legal
status: current
---
Northwind keeps personal data only as long as it is needed for the purpose it was
collected for, or as long as a legal obligation requires. Retention periods are
set per data category and are enforced by automated deletion rather than by
anyone remembering to run a job.

Shipment records including consignee name and address are retained for seven
years from the delivery date. The seven year period comes from customs and tax
obligations, not from a commercial preference, and cannot be shortened by a
customer request.

Proof of delivery signatures and photographs are retained for two years. Delivery
photographs are captured at the doorstep and are cropped automatically to exclude
the interior of a property; an uncropped image found in the record is raised as
an incident to the platform support team.

Telematics data including vehicle location is retained for twelve months. Driver
behaviour scores derived from it are retained for twenty four months and are
never used as the sole basis for a disciplinary decision.

Recruitment records for unsuccessful candidates are deleted after twelve months
unless the candidate has asked to be kept on file, in which case the record is
deleted after twenty four months.

Customer support contact records including call recordings are retained for
twenty four months. A recording that forms part of an open dispute is preserved
beyond that period until the dispute closes, and the preservation is recorded
against the case rather than applied silently.

Backups follow the same retention periods as the live systems, with a maximum
additional lag of thirty five days. A deletion request is therefore fully
satisfied thirty five days after it is applied to the live record, and the legal
team tells customers this rather than claiming immediate deletion.
